text: Evening. My grandson is one month old and his temperature is 38.2. He has some small dark reddish dots come up on his tummy and chest in the last hour or so. I pressed a drinking glass against them like you see on the posters and I could still see them clear as anything through the side. His neck seems fine, he tucks his chin down when I change him without any fuss. His mum is asleep and I didn't want to wake her if there's no need, so I thought I'd check with you first what to do.
